_about: Expert review of Maya Audit cards: one SEO expert's verdict per card, kept as accuracy data (DECISIONS 338). verdict: the expert's (correct, wrong, wording, incomplete); assessment: what the saved evidence showed when checked (agree, right, mostly_right, partly_right, not_supported). follow_up: rules whose verdict was wrong.

cards.title: Head'i erken kapatan öğeyi taşıyın
cards.expert_note: Düzenlenme Önerisi hatalı, hatalı bulgu var öneriye göre heas kısmı zaten kapsıyor
cards.finding: The break is real and in the site's own HTML (div#blueLightOverlay inside <head>, 121 of 128 pages); canonical, hreflang and title stay before it. High came from a robots tag after the break whose value was never recorded.
cards.fix: High only when a canonical, hreflang or title (with no copy before the break) or a restricting robots value is lost; the robots value is recorded; the card says what stays in the head and what comes after.

cards.title: Hata veren sayfalara giden bağlantıları düzeltin ya da kaldırın
cards.finding: No page read links to the 21 addresses: all are sitemap entries (302 → 404).
cards.fix: DECISIONS 337: own sitemap card, file per address, Bağlantı yerleri.

cards.title: Tarayıcıları engelleyen robots.txt kuralını gözden geçirin
cards.expert_note: Robots'ta parametre eklendiyse bilerek yapılmıştır öneri vermeye gerek yok
cards.finding: The rules block ?ref= parameters, legacy *.aspx and a form path; no page the site puts forward is blocked.
cards.fix: Parameter, old-script and form-path rules that reach no homepage, key page or sitemap address are Info, "bilinçli görünüyor, teyit edin".

cards.title: Marka için sitede tek bir ad kullanın
cards.expert_note: Hata bulunan sayfalarda hata yok, önerideki mevcut
cards.finding: Of five names, "Enpara.com" (domain form) and "Enpara Şirketim" (sub-brand) are normal; "Bankanın güzeli | Enpara" and "Homepage" as Organization names are real, on 2 pages; the card listed all 111 pages naming the brand.
cards.fix: Domain form folded into the brand, section sub-brands not counted, only pages with another name listed.

cards.title: Ana başlığı olmayan sayfalara tek bir ana başlık ekleyin
cards.expert_note: Hata tanımı yanlış, H1 Etiketi eklenmeli olmalı, ana başlık değil
cards.finding: Wording: the team report said "ana başlık" for <h1>.
cards.fix: Every H1 rule's Turkish team-report text says "H1 etiketi".

cards.title: Aynı açıklamayı paylaşan sayfalara ayrı açıklama yazın
Uzun sayfalara bölüm başlıkları ekleyin
cards.expert_note: Hatalı bir çıkarım, sayfalar içinde başlıklar var
cards.finding: Neither copy of the 4 pages has <h2>/<h3>; /bilgi-bankasi is a listing page; visible titles are styled text (raw HTML not saved to confirm).
cards.fix: Listing pages left out; styled section titles counted (new audits) and said as "mark them H2/H3"; card wording names H2/H3.

cards.title: http'den https'e yönlendirmeyi kalıcı yapın
cards.finding: The 302 is real (4 requests, one hop) but the https pages send HSTS for 1825 days.
cards.fix: Info under HSTS of a year or more.

cards.title: Küçük bağlantı ve etiket tutarsızlıklarını temizleyin
cards.expert_note: Hangi sayfalar yönlendiridiği yazmıyor, eksik öneri
cards.finding: The redirect items carried no addresses; the internal-link item repeated card 8.
cards.fix: Every item lists its addresses and what redirects where; the repeat dropped; the Ek has a row per address.

cards.title: Soru başlıklarını düzeltin
cards.finding: The card showed 5 of 24 pages and had no rows in the Ek (its id named a check, not a finding).
cards.fix: Every page kept (new audits) with its questions; rows in the Ek; unlisted pages counted.
